messages:
Jordan P: Quick callout 52 I'm seeing `The requested module ... does not provide an export named 'default'` when importing redwood-sdk-js from an Edge runtime inside our pnpm monorepo. Local bundle works fine. Anyone seen ESM/CJS + pnpm symlink weirdness?

Nina S: Yep. pnpm's node_modules layout + package `exports` can confuse edge loaders. How are you importing the SDK?

Jordan P: `import { Client } from 'redwood-sdk-js'` in an edge function file. package.json for the SDK points to cjs/esm via exports.

Liam H: Two likely issues: 1) runtime ends up loading the CJS entry because of how the symlink path resolves, 2) bundler config might be treating the package as external and letting the runtime load the on-disk CJS file.

Ravi M: Workarounds we've used: publish an explicit ESM-only subpath like `redwood-sdk-js/edge` and add an `exports` entry for `./edge` -> `dist/edge/index.mjs`. Then import that in edge handlers.

Jordan P: Could also add a tiny top-level ESM file that re-exports from dist/esm so the loader sees an ESM package root?

Nina S: Exactly. Example `exports` snippet we've shipped: { ".": { "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts", "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js" }, "./edge": { "import": "./dist/edge/index.mjs" } }

Liam H: For TS in workspaces add `typesVersions` so `redwood-sdk-js/edge` resolves types correctly. Also consider a small `dist/edge/index.d.ts` that re-exports the Client type.

Jordan P: Tried adding `./edge` and a wrapper mjs file, still failed on Vercel deploy. Local repro outside monorepo (npm install) works. So it's definitely pnpm layout related.

Ravi M: Short-term hack: `shamefully-hoist=true` during build to flatten node_modules. Not great for customers. Longer-term: publish the edge entry and add a CI test that runs in an edge-like environment to catch regressions.

build-bot: Built internal release 0.12.1-edge.1 with ./edge export at 1719876620.

Jordan P: Using hoist in CI now to unblock deploys. I'll open a PR to add the `./edge` export, typesVersions, and a README note about pnpm hoisting pitfalls. Thanks for the triage.

Nina S: If anyone hits type resolution for `/edge`, tag me and I'll add the tiny d.ts re-exports.

Liam H: Also add a short note in our SDK README about preferred import patterns for edge runtimes.

Jordan P: Will do.
